story: AMA: Ivan Kutskir, creator of Photopea
text: Hey Ivan, congrats! Had a great time with you 2 years ago when you came to Nantes, France to explain "Developing the best free photo editor". Check-out his explanations here: [VIDEO] Legend.

story: Founder came back after 8 years to rewrite Flash photo editor in Canvas/WebGL
text: Yes, Photopea is only one HTML, one CSS and many JS files. It is about 1.5 MB in total. I pay 40 USD a year for the hosting + 12 USD a year for the .com domain. I gave a talk about it: [VIDEO]
